title: AI-POWERED STUDENT ASSISTANCE CHATBOT USING NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING FOR BUKSU
description:
Dear Respondent,
You are invited to participate in a study evaluating the AI-Based Help Desk Chatbot System developed for Bukidnon State University students. This questionnaire aims to assess the system in terms of its usability, accuracy, and effectiveness as a student assistance tool. Please answer each item based on your actual experience using the chatbot.
Your responses will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely for academic purposes. There are no right or wrong answers kindly answer as honestly as possible.
Thank you very much for your time and cooperation.
The Researchers
